title: Club Brazil in Los Angeles and the Concord Hotel
summary: The band plays Club Brazil in L.A. and wins over the Concord Hotel despite objections.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: (inaudible), and from there first band that go out of New York go to California. (inaudible) 13 week contract in Club Brazil (showing).
: Where is that, in L.A. or --

In L.A., right in Chinatown, Club Brazil, right by Chinatown, right in Chinatown, Club Brazil. They're the talk of the town. Every night, nothing but a celebrity, (inaudible) Bing Crosby, Carmen Miranda, all the big, every (inaudible) Bing Crosby (inaudible). I got pictures of all of that. It was a big thing, Machido, Machido, Machido, Machido (inaudible).

Then back in New York again, and I go to the Concord Hotel, the swanky summer resort. We go there. They call the man to -- you don't take those niggers over there. The people smoke marijuana and all that, you know, and they got them living on the premises and all that. So Mr. ______, he say, I don't care what you people say. I've got to see it for myself.

So we opened there. The man went crazy. He called me and said, Mario, as long as I own this club, this hotel, (inaudible). We make 20 seasons with our group, year after year, year after year, until we got of tired and didn't want to go back (inaudible).
